featured_reviews.name: Ketan Choudhari
featured_reviews.review_text:
CnC is a dessert cum CAFE located Off LBS Marg near Johnson n Johnson company in Mulund.

They serve some lip smacking food along with unique desserts.. especially pastries...

I visited them to try out their ⏭⏭NEW MENU⏪⏪ which had some unique dishes... as below

HAZELNUT HOT CHOCOLATE:
This ws amazing. Best thng to have in the MONSOON!!

STRAWBERRY WHITE CHOCOLATE:
This ws a lil too sweet for my palate. A Lil less sweet can make it intrstng.

KAFFIR LIME BREATHER:
One of the best cooler... Alwayz in LOVE with Kaffir Lime Drinks!! It gives a nice flavor.

For Food tried a variety of NEWLY LAUNCHED DISHES!!

MANCHOW SOUP:
A lil extra tangy on the palate but amazing. The quantity is great... Recommended to be shared between 3

THAI PEANUT SALAD:
This ws a lil sweet for my palate. The veggies wer amazing along wid good taste of peanut.

PALAK KI TIKKI:
CRISPY PALAK TIKKI served on Bread piece and gsrnished with cherry tomato... The balance of flavors ws good. Spinach didnt overpower completely...

COTTAGE CHEESE CILANTRO
FRESH COTTAGE CHEESE tossed in tangy Cialntro sauce. It had a mexican salsa kinda taste.. Lobed the flavor that came out. DEFINITELY RECOMMENDED...

PALAK PANEER RICE
This ws nicely made and came im 2 colors. ORANGE & GREEN. The green obviously had the prominent palak flavor. The orange had lil less seasoning I felt. A lil garlic flavor Could do the magic.

BABY CORN KURKURE
One of the best munchies for the monsoon... The best thng was the babycorns were cut into long stripes... which made them extra crisp.. Secondly.. the mint chutney dat came along ws BOMB!! MUST ORDER...

FINALLY, IN DESSERTS... tried a Shake & Pastry..

BROOKIES FREAKSHAKE
This was a loaded with goodness of chocolate brownies... recommended to be shared between 2-3 ppl.

ANGOOR RABDI PASTRY
Trying This ws a nice idea, as I hav alwayz tried Chocolate based pastry evrywer. This had perfect amount of sweetness dat u need. It ws Super cream... MUST ORDER!!

THE NEW ADDITION TO THE MENU @ CAKES N CHEM is definitely an interesting idea by the Team...

Although im editing this review since one time they forgot to add details to a customized cake and honestly it was disappointing to which I told them what went wrong and they tried to correct it only after mentioning that these things were missing from the cake, other than that for my 25th birthday they refused to bake a cake “saying that she has high expectations from us and we wouldn’t want to bake a cake for her” this was only because I corrected them, and it was the team’s fault. It’s very disappointing from a customer’s point of view since all I did was let them know what was wrong 🙂
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Hi Amber,

Thank you for your honest feedback, and I’m truly sorry if it felt like your order was declined because you corrected me. That was not my intention at all.

In my 20+ years of baking professionally, I’ve learned that feedback is an important part of the process, and I always welcome it as it helps us do better.

The request for your birthday fell on a Tuesday, which is our weekly day off. I was concerned that preparing the cake a day in advance, given the design you had chosen, might affect how it looked and held up. As I already had prior commitments that day, I didn’t want to risk compromising the final result for such an important occasion.

My only intention was to ensure that your celebration received the quality it deserves.

I sincerely apologise for any disappointment caused.

Warm regards,
Fay

Seeing a different design at the last minute was a major letdown. I hope Indulge takes customer requirements and communication more seriously in the future.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Hello Isha,

We were quite surprised to see your one-star review.

When we initially asked for feedback, you mentioned that everyone loved the cake, although you personally didn’t get a chance to see or taste it as you were occupied at the time. Later, you shared an image taken from the back of the cake at an unusual angle and mentioned that certain elements were missing, even though they are still partially visible in the same image.

We’re genuinely open to feedback and always use it to improve our work. However, this particular review feels confusing and does not fully align with our discussions about design and flavour.

For clarity and transparency, we have posted our image of the cake on our google profile as well as attached our initial conversation along with a clearer image of the cake for anyone who would like to understand the full context on an unlisted page on our website linked below.

I do apologise if you or your guests were dissatisfied with the cake, we will try and communicate more clearly in the future to avoid any misunderstandings.

We remain committed to honest communication and delivering quality, and we truly value feedback that helps us grow.

Thanks & regards,
Indulge Custom Cakes
